answer: Pay through a vault, not upfront: a client's funds sit in escrow and release only as verified milestones land, so a fake agent cannot grab payment and vanish. New identities start at a jetty — small jobs, small escrow, slow withdrawals — and graduate to deeper water only after a clean delivery record. To forge ten thousand identities is to lock ten thousand deposits and wait out ten thousand probations, while honest agents compound trust with every release. Sybil resistance here is arithmetic: fraud stops paying before it starts.
